com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Replace an invoice's observed billing and settlement exchange rates, date and note. Optional values left out are cleared. Original invoice amounts remain unchanged; this records information without initiating payment. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: For our selected fictional practice invoice, preview recording base currency USD, observed billing rate 1.08, settlement rate 1.10, settlement date 2026-10-01 and note Practice exchange-rate annotation. Show the full replacement and confirm this records information without initiating payment, then wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_set_invoice_settlement, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare replacing the observed billing/settlement rates and optional date/note. Omitted optional fields are cleared; original invoice amounts remain. No payment is initiated. Requires confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

name: set_invoice_settlement
title: Record invoice exchange rates
